links.outcome: Readability (SMOG, Flesch-Kincaid, Flesch Reading Ease) of myopia education text across race, ethnicity and gender prompt modifiers
links.effect: No readability differences by gender, race, or ethnicity for ChatGPT or Copilot; Gemini readability differed significantly by race in the prompt (p<0.05). 150 responses analyzed.
links.quote: Gemini-generated responses differed significantly in their SMOG Index, Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level, and Flesch Reading Ease based on the race mentioned in the prompt (p<0.05).

screen.reason: Evaluates bias/disparities in LLM-generated patient education materials by testing prompt demographic modifiers on readability scores.
